scope: Exact frozen engineering prototype and receipts; independent long-scale readiness, not canonical engineering milestone acceptance
criticism: The prototype preserves provisional identity and conservative exclusions, but fixed CPU termination, unchecked finalization, pinned staging snapshots and missing fidelity controls block a reliable long-scale launch.
findings: CLI hard-codes RLIMIT_CPU=300 independent of --seconds; default SIGXCPU termination bypasses FAIL_RETAINED
Deadline checks do not cover FTS integrity, VACUUM, SQLite integrity and whole-index hashing
Long source read transaction can pin staging WAL while append-only acquisition grows
Invalid JSON or inconsistent staged metadata can abort outside retained per-record exclusions
Frozen receipts alone lack independently inspectable original reconstruction, UTF16, conflict and mixed-license test outputs; reader validates capsule without original HTML retrieval
positive_limitations: Conservative conflicts prevent unsafe latest revisions reviving older output
Math/table articles are explicitly unsuitable for research candidacy
Original bytes externally referenced rather than reconstructed by reader
